1879053069.name: In Defence of Middle-earth
1879053069.desc: Your very presence inspires those around you to perform better in combat.

1879059853.name: Ferocious Strikes
1879059853.desc: Makes three deadly attacks.\n\nThis attack can only be evaded; it will never miss, be parried by or blocked by an on level opponent.

1879060621.name: Vexing Blow
1879060621.desc: A quick swipe that will strike multiple enemies.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.

1879060749.name: Staff Strike
1879060749.desc: Strike hard with your staff. If your pet is flanking the enemy, you will deal bonus damage.

1879061005.name: Hide in Plain Sight
1879061005.desc: Disappear from before the enemy's eyes.\n\nBriefly improves Stealth. Using this skill will not break Stealth.

conditionalEffects.description: Hide in Plain Sight removes some Poison, Disease, Fear and Wound effects from the Burglar.

1879064077.name: Horn of Gondor
1879064077.desc: Makes a full AoE attack, which stuns your opponents.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Stun replaced with a mount speed debuff</rgb>

1879064333.name: Exploit Opening
1879064333.desc: Stun an enemy to enable a Fellowship Manoeuvre for your group.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879072525.name: Resilience
1879072525.desc: You are hardier than most and can recover from most crowd control effects.

1879073293.name: Stealthed Cunning Attack
1879073293.desc: Deals damage even after the initial strike.\n\nThe bleed deals more damage while Stealthed.

conditionalEffects.description: Stealthed Cunning Attack reduces the active cooldown of Knives Out.

1879073677.name: Devastating Strike
1879073677.desc: When your target has less than 50% of their morale, you can make an extremely damaging attack with an increased chance to critical.

1879091725.name: To Arms (Shield-brother)
1879091725.desc: Briefly increases the defence of your Shield-brother.

conditionalEffects.description: You gain a personal benefit when using To Arms.
Your Inspire (Shield-brother) and To Arms (Shield-brother) apply minor bonuses to the rest of your Fellowship.
Your Inspire (Shield-brother) and To Arms (Shield-brother) apply minor bonuses to the rest of your Fellowship.
Your Inspire (Shield-brother) and To Arms (Shield-brother) apply minor bonuses to the rest of your Fellowship.

1879094797.name: Bane Flare
1879094797.desc: A flare in the sky dazes enemies, but damage will break their stupor.

1879099277.name: Mentor: Theorbo
1879099277.desc: You can instruct someone how to play the theorbo.

1879115149.name: Dark Future
1879115149.desc: Power loss over time effect and reduces in and out of combat power regeneration to 0 for 30 seconds. The prospects of victory against Amarthiel seem slim, sapping the player of power.

1879145101.name: Desperate Flight
1879145101.desc: Escape from danger and travel to a nearby rally point.\n\nWhile in PvMP areas, this skill cannot be used in combat.

1879146125.name: Warding Knowledge
1879146125.desc: Creates a warded circle in which you and your allies take reduced damage.

1879186701.name: Blood Arrow
1879186701.desc: A damaging shot that also restores the Hunter's Morale.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.
Blood Arrow heals +5% of Max Morale over time.
Blood Arrow heals +10% of Max Morale over time.

procEffects.description: On every Harmful skill,\n50% chance on Critical Hit:
On every Harmful skill,\nOn Critical Hit:

1879198349.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Dusky Sabre-cat)
1879198349.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879200653.name: Lethargic Poison
1879200653.desc: Your hatchling injects your target with poison, causing severe lethargy.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Consumes Venomous Haze to increase incoming damage by 5% for 30s.</rgb>

1879208717.name: Essence of Toad
1879208717.desc: Essence of Toad has a million and one uses. Whether it's a troublesome enemy, an annoying friend, or a beautiful woman who's out of your league, in the end all glory will be yours.\n\nWill cause nearby players to faint.

1879214605.name: Exultation of Battle
1879214605.desc:
Wardens find strength in the sure knowledge that they are fighting to defend the defenceless.
Drains significant morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879232781.name: Mending Verse
1879232781.desc: Hardships are forgotten and spirits are lifted by such writings. This heal over time stacks with itself. -1% Power cost per Healing Attunement.

conditionalEffects.description: Epic for The Ages, Mending Verse, and Rousing Words heal the Rune-keeper for:  *

1879239565.name: Seeking Arrow
1879239565.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879241485.name: Enheartening Valiant Strike
1879241485.desc: A strike that instantly heals the Morale of nearby Fellows, and also grants a Heal-over-time.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879241997.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879241997.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline turns your focus to steering the course of battle while maintaining your ability to protect allies from enemy assault.

1879243917.name: Improved Bracing Attack
1879243917.desc: You make an attack which allows you to brace yourself against counterattack, increasing your Morale by a small amount. Your Morale will increase even if this attack is avoided.

1879251341.name: Muster in Snowbourn
1879251341.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Snowbourn in eastern Rohan.

1879301901.name: Improved Standard of Valour
1879301901.desc: Calls forth the Standard of Valour, dealing damage to enemies while increasing the Morale healed to nearby allies.

1879307149.name: Spotted Shrew
1879307149.desc: Summons a spotted shrew to brighten your day.

1879315085.name: Recuperate
1879315085.desc: You consume some of your Wrath to regain some Morale in the heat of battle.

1879332621.name: Distant Cousin
1879332621.desc: Summons a distant cousin from the Stoors to keep you company.

1879343757.name: Steed of the Reminiscing Dragon
1879343757.desc: A hard-won steed from the 10-year Anniversary Festival.

1879344397.name: Lithe Festival Horse
1879344397.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879389709.name: Little Brown Pig
1879389709.desc: Brings out a little brown pig to keep you company.

1879392269.name: Steed of the Great Alliance
1879392269.desc: A steed representing the Great Alliance of Elves and Men who faced Sauron at the end of the Second Age.

1879408653.name: Ringló Steed
1879408653.desc: A proud steed of Ringló Vale.

1879411085.name: Dark Grey Squirrel
1879411085.desc: A little squirrel who would like to see the world with you.

1879457549.name: Unseen Strikes
1879457549.desc:
A series of impossibly fast attacks strike your opponents.

This skill will consume any War Cry, Brink of Victory, Surety of Death, or Desolation damage over time effects on your targets, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879483277.name: Reckless Slam
1879483277.desc: Bring down your weight with great force upon your foe.

1879506573.name: Ice Pillar
1879506573.desc: Target the earth and pull forth a pillar of ice that sheds damaging ice shards to all nearby.

1879506829.name: Misdirection
1879506829.desc: Beguile your target and leave them bleeding with deep wounds.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879515021.name: Jaunty Monkey
1879515021.desc: Summons a bold and mischievous monkey to accompany you on your travels.

1879527437.name: Delothlin Gem
1879527437.desc: Channel the power of the gem to cleanse the target of the TBD Curse. This power will also harm the user.
